newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose sharply to 3.137 billion yuan from 2.087 billion with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.

Trading was more active than Monday with non-banking financial institutions including securities houses borrowing heavily from the short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, traders said.
Traders said the financial institutions turned to the interbank market to borrow money after Beijing announced last Friday that it had set up a national state debt depository.

"The depository will gradually make it impossible for them to borrow funds from the securities exchanges and state debt trading centres using the same state debt certificates," said a trader. "This has made them resort to the interbank market."
